commands.name: GYRO_CAL
commands.desc: craft must be still; ~1 s, progress in the calibration stream

commands.name: ACC_CAL_POINT
commands.desc: average ~1 s of accel with the craft still on one of its 6 faces; the face is detected automatically (see calibration.mask)

commands.name: ACC_CAL_FINISH
commands.desc: needs all 6 faces; fits offset+scale and stores them in the calibration section (RAM - save to keep)

commands.name: LEVEL_TRIM
commands.desc: craft must sit level and still; stores acc_trim_roll/pitch (RAM - save to keep)

commands.name: MAG_CAL_FINISH
commands.desc: fits the ellipsoid; on success the calibration is in use and stored in the calibration section (RAM - save to keep). On ERR_FAILED `reason` says why and the calibration keeps collecting

commands.name: MOTOR_TEST
commands.desc: motor = logical motor index, 255 = all; value 0..1000 = 0..100 %. Must be refreshed at least every 0.5 s or the motor stops. Refused while armed. REMOVE THE PROPELLERS

commands.name: MOTOR_DIRECTION
commands.desc: queues the ESC spin-direction DShot command (disarmed only)

commands.name: APPLY_SETTINGS
commands.desc: re-apply the RAM settings to the running firmware (disarmed only)

commands.name: REPORT
commands.desc: re-send the boot report (detected sensors / failure reasons) as LOG frames

commands.name: BEEP
commands.desc: play the sound of one beeper condition once on the buzzer and (when they can beep) the motors, even if that condition is switched off; 255 (none) = silence. Refused while armed

commands.name: BLACKBOX_ERASE
commands.desc: erase the whole log memory (takes seconds; progress in the blackbox stream). Refused while armed or logging

commands.name: BLACKBOX_STREAM
commands.desc: send the log to the app as BB_HEADER / BB_DATA frames instead of storing it; rate_hz 0 = the configured rate. A running storage session is closed first (refused with BUSY while armed). Stops by itself when the app goes silent

commands.name: BLACKBOX_SESSION
commands.desc: position of stored session `index` (0 = oldest) in the log memory; BAD_ARG past the last one

commands.name: BLACKBOX_READ
commands.desc: start sending `length` bytes of the log memory from `offset` as BB_BLOB frames [offset u32][data]; length 0 cancels. Refused while armed, logging or erasing

commands.name: MAG_AUTOCAL
commands.desc: the automatic compass calibration (Betaflight 4.5 style): turn the craft around by hand within 15 s; it ends by itself (progress, state and result in the calibration stream) and the new hard-iron offset is applied and saved to flash by the firmware. Stick command: throttle high, pitch back, roll and yaw centred, 1 s, disarmed

commands.name: MISSION
commands.desc: action 1 = start the stored mission (the craft must be armed by the pilot; on the ground the first command must be TAKEOFF), 0 = stop it (the pilot's modes fly again). FAILED: refused

commands.name: BIND
commands.desc: nRF24: 1 = start binding (transmitter: send the bind offer; receiver: listen for it), 0 = stop. Refused while armed

commands.name: STICK_CAL
commands.desc: transmitter: 1 = start (move every stick to its ends), 2 = finish (the ends seen + where the sticks rest now = the centre), 0 = cancel

result.desc: axes calibrated (an axis not moved far enough keeps its old calibration)
